About

At TechTonePrints, we utilise modern technology and AI assisted creative tools to create and curate artwork around the needs of your project.

Our process gives you greater flexibility over colour, composition and mood, making artwork sourcing simpler, faster and more efficient. From a single space to larger projects, we can build cohesive collections around your brief and make adjustments as your project develops.

Every piece is delivered digitally as a high resolution, print ready file, giving you complete flexibility over how, where and when it’s produced. Print locally to reduce lead times and shipping costs, choose the materials and finishes that suit the space, produce artwork at the required size, and easily reorder or reproduce pieces whenever they’re needed.

With no physical inventory to store, no artwork to ship internationally and files available for future projects, digital artwork offers a more flexible and efficient way to source art across individual rooms, entire properties or multiple locations.

About

At TechTonePrints, we utilise modern technology and AI assisted creative tools to create and curate artwork around the needs of your project.

Our process gives you greater flexibility over colour, composition and mood, making artwork sourcing simpler, faster and more efficient. From a single space to larger projects, we can build cohesive collections around your brief and make adjustments as your project develops.

Every piece is delivered digitally as a high resolution, print ready file, giving you complete flexibility over how, where and when it’s produced. Print locally to reduce lead times and shipping costs, choose the materials and finishes that suit the space, produce artwork at the required size, and easily reorder or reproduce pieces whenever they’re needed.

With no physical inventory to store, no artwork to ship internationally and files available for future projects, digital artwork offers a more flexible and efficient way to source art across individual rooms, entire properties or multiple locations.

Artwork that works with your space

TechTonePrints creates and curates digital artwork for interior designers, home stagers, holiday properties and hospitality spaces. Whether you need a few pieces to finish one room or a coordinated collection across an entire property, we help you find artwork that feels considered, consistent and right for the brief. You receive digital files ready for professional printing at the sizes agreed for your project.

Why digital artwork?

Choose your own finish

Have the artwork printed and framed by the supplier that suits your project, budget and location.

Get the sizes you need

We prepare files for agreed print dimensions, so your artwork fits the intended space. Available sizes depend on the artwork.

Keep a consistent look across rooms

A coordinated collection makes it easier to carry colours, textures and character through a property.

Move faster

Review artwork in digital mockups, approve your selection and send the final files to your chosen printer without waiting for physical artwork to ship.

Work across locations

Digital delivery makes collaboration straightforward wherever your designer, client or printing partner is based. Licensing for more than one property can be arranged separately, making it easy to keep continuity between projects in different locations, domestic and overseas.

Not sure of the right direction?

Share a photo of the room, project or style you are working with. We can use it to guide artwork that suits the space naturally, rather than simply being added to it.

Project Edit

£149

For one room or a small project

A considered selection of three existing artworks chosen around your brief, with an artwork mockup and print ready files at agreed sizes. Includes a licence for one named project or property.

Property Collection

From £399to £449

For a whole property that needs to feel connected

Six to ten coordinating artworks selected for your rooms, with artwork mockups, print ready files at agreed sizes and one round of changes to the selection. Includes a licence for one named property. Final pricing depends on the number of artworks and the project brief.

Bespoke Collection

From £900and up

For a distinct space or a more specific creative brief

Artwork newly created or substantially adapted for your project. We agree the number of pieces, sizes, creative direction and usage rights before work begins. Multi property projects and exclusive use are quoted individually.

Custom Collection

Price on request

For spaces and projects of any size that need a more tailored approach

Tell us about the space, the style you’re after and how the artwork will be used. We can put together a collection from our existing artwork, or create new artwork that suits your project needs, with tailored selections or adjustments where needed. The number of pieces, print sizes, mockups and licence are agreed around your brief, with a clear quote before work begins.

How it works

  1. 1

    Share your brief

    Send photos, plans or references, along with the rooms, preferred sizes and the atmosphere you want to create.

  2. 2

    Review the artwork

    We present a selection with mockups so you can see how the pieces could work in the space.

  3. 3

    Receive your files

    Once approved, we prepare the agreed artwork files for you, with the licence for your project clearly set out.
